combinations.reason: No case combines the two, on either of the two scans this rests on, which look for different things. Scan one, the mappings that declare event-sourcing under tests/: two of them come with a Rust source tree, tests/golden/rust/t2-cases.ts:59 (module at the crate root, :66; only its derived clean-b-split-replay uses the file child at :27) and tests/golden/packaging/cases.ts:64 (its one case with a replay is clean-packaging-path-replay at :438-453, its replay at :445, placed behind #[path]). The other five declare the value in a mapping document that writes no Rust source at all, so none of them claims a physical placement: tests/rust-mapping-view.test.ts:87 (its viewOf at :58-67 writes the record files only), tests/fixtures/aggregate-mapping/workspace.ts:210 and :368, tests/aggregate-mapping-migration.test.ts:109, tests/artifact-set-migration.test.ts:197. The remaining occurrence, tests/golden/rust/t2-cases.ts:163, is the derivation tuple that removes the value rather than a mapping that declares it. Scan two, the modules that a case carrying an aggregate mapping writes into a mod.rs under tests/, module placement meaning here the physical placement of the modules the case writes. A case that writes a mod.rs without any aggregate mapping declares no persistence_method, so it cannot combine with event-sourcing and is outside this scan: the module-layout specimens in tests/golden/module-layout/cases.ts (:19 records that they carry no domain model), tests/t10-rust-module-layout.test.ts and tests/error-contract-rust.test.ts. Within the scan there are four, tests/golden/rust/domain-facts-cases.ts:109-112 (MOD_RS at :15), tests/golden/packaging/cases.ts:255-258, tests/golden/packaging/cases.ts:378-380 (the conflict case, which keeps invoice.rs beside the mod.rs) and tests/operation-error-set-languages.test.ts:419. All four are state-sourcing, so the two sets do not meet. In three of the four the aggregate the mapping declares still sits at the crate root (tests/golden/package-fixture.ts:53 and ROOT_PACKAGE at tests/golden/packaging/cases.ts:22-27, consumed at :68, both module: []), and what the mod.rs holds is a claimed source file or a mapped domain package. Only tests/operation-error-set-languages.test.ts:419 puts the mapped aggregate's own module in a mod.rs, and that mapping is state-sourcing as well (tests/fixtures/operation-error-set/records/rust/inception/domain-design/ddd-aggregate-mapping.md:10-11), so the gap holds on the narrower reading too.

limits: This is a survey of the existing tests at one commit, not a coverage guarantee. No script generates it and no check compares it against the cases, so a later case will not update it.

Verified here means a case exercises the combination, not that the combination is fully specified. Detailed strategy-specific checks remain incomplete, as docs/developers/domain-layer-design.md states.
The gaps are gaps in the tests. They are not statements that a combination is unsupported or invalid; programming_model and persistence_method stay independent choices.

No golden case definition puts a declared layout and a mapped aggregate together. Paths c and d both hold a mapping, real sources and a layout setting at once, and both carry only class x state-sourcing. Path c does carry a declared mod-rs layout beside a mapping, as its combination row records, but it uses that setting only to resolve where the mapped module should be; it never runs the layout inspection. checkModuleLayout (tools/ddd/lib/module-layout/check.ts:85-88) takes an extractor, a project root and a budget callback, and no mapping; its shipped callers are tools/ddd-check-rust-module-layout.ts:11 and tools/ddd-sensor-rust-module-layout.ts:15, the only other callers are the direct ones in tests/t10-rust-module-layout.test.ts (:68, :75, :80, :87, :226, :266, :414), which are path a and carry no mapping, and operation-error-set-verification is not among them. Path d is the only path that runs the layout inspection and the Rust source rules against a mapping in one execution, and it covers just the declared file layout over two packaging cases. So no path runs the layout inspection together with a mapping under a declared mod-rs layout.
